pie: ḱwṓ moysóns péh₂st. nu h₁ludʰét wl̥kʷíh₂s wérh₁t-kʷe tósmey. ḱwón moy h₂ówim dh₃dʰí h₂epó-kʷe léytoh₂. só sékʷt. tā́m toy ne dédeh₃mi. méne moysṓs ne h₁sénti h₁esh₂ósyo téh₂es h₁sénti. léytt wl̥kʷíh₂s. h₁yós péh₂sti só wĺ̥kʷōy h₂ówim ne dédeh₃ti.
english: The dog was guarding the sheep. Then the she-wolf came and said to the dog: "Dog, give me a sheep, and I will go away." He said: "I do not give her to you. The sheep are not mine; they are the master's." The she-wolf went away. He who guards does not give a sheep to the wolf.

pie: súHnu gʰostéyey wódr̥ dh₃dʰí. gʰóstim ph₂wéni sodéye. gʰóstim h₂epó mē h₂éǵes. h₁yós gʰostéyey dédeh₃ti só deywóybʰos dédeh₃ti. h₁yód gʰóstis h₁r̥sḱéti úd sth₂dʰí. gʰostéyey pékʷe.
english: Son, give the guest water. Seat the guest at the fire. Do not drive the guest away. He who gives to the guest gives to the gods. When a guest arrives, stand up. Cook for the guest.

pie: wĺ̥kʷos ḱwónm̥ widét wérh₁t-kʷe tósmey. ḱwón pl̥h₁nós h₁ési. h₁eǵ tr̥syóh₂. h₂éǵt ḱwṓ. wĺ̥kʷe me sékʷeso h₁esh₂ós me h₂életi. h₁léwdʰeros h₁ési? h₁léwdʰeros ne h₁ésmi. nu te ḱwón ne sékʷoh₂er. h₁léwdʰeros tr̥syéti pl̥h₁nós h₁léwdʰeros ne h₁ésti.
english: The wolf saw a dog and said to him: "Dog, you are full. I am thirsty." The dog said: "Follow me, wolf. The master nourishes me." "Are you free?" "I am not free." "Then, dog, I do not follow you." The free one is thirsty; the full one is not free.

pie: bʰréh₂tēr bʰréh₂term̥ ne gʷʰénti. méh₂tēr dʰugh₂térm̥ h₂életi. dʰugh₂tḗr méh₂term̥ sékʷetor. swóm ph₂térm̥ mē linékʷs. bʰréh₂teres mért túH-ge mérs. h₁wésu ḱléwos ne néḱt.
english: A brother does not kill a brother. The mother nourishes the daughter. The daughter follows the mother. Do not leave your own father. Brothers die, you yourself die. Good fame does not vanish.

pie: akwāsas ā wawakant: krudʰi awai, kard agʰnutai wiwidwant- swas: manus patis warnām awisāms karnauti swabʰyam gʰarmam wastram awibʰyams ka warnā na asti.
english: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

pie: súHnu swóm ph₂térm̥ ḱléwse. bʰréh₂term̥ mē stunéds. ph₂tréy dʰrówgʰom mē wérh₁yes. swésōr bʰréh₂term̥ sékʷetor. dwóh₁ bʰréh₂terh₁ h₃énHos bʰéretes. ph₂tḗr-kʷe méh₂tēr dʰugh₂térm̥ h₂életes.
english: Son, listen to your own father. Do not strike a brother. Do not speak a lie to your father. The sister follows the brother. Two brothers carry the load. Father and mother nourish the daughter.

pie: h₂éwis múHsm̥ sérpontm̥ h₁ógʷʰim widét. mléwHt tósmey. múHs te h₁ógʷʰis sérpeti. h₂epó litdʰí. ḱléwt só tā́m h₂epó-kʷe gʷéh₂t. h₁ógʷʰis tóm ne h₁épt. h₁yós h₁wésu wékʷos ḱléwseti spr̥tó só.
english: A bird saw a snake creeping toward a mouse. She said to him: "Mouse, the snake creeps to you. Go away!" The mouse heard her and went away. The snake did not seize the mouse. Whoever hears a good word saves himself.

pie: dwóh₁ moysóh₁ h₂éǵroy sth₂éh₁yetām. h₁ést sḿ̥teros ǵérh₂onts h₁ést sḿ̥teros h₂yuHn̥ḱós. nu snóygʷʰos gʷémt. wérh₁t h₂yuHn̥ḱós. méǵh₂s h₁ésmi. snóygʷʰom ne bʰebʰóyh₂h₂e. sékʷt ǵérh₂onts. snóygʷʰom ǵn̥néh₃mi. ḱḗr moy trémti. h₂yuHn̥ḱós stéwdt. h₂yuHn̥ḱós méǵh₂s h₁ésti ǵérh₂onts wóyde.
english: Two rams stood in the field. One of the two was old, one of the two was young. Then snow came. The young one said: "I am big. I do not fear the snow." The old one said: "I know the snow. My heart trembles." The young one became cold. The young one is big; the old one knows.

pie: h₂ówis h₁éḱwōskʷe
english: The Sheep and the Horses

pie: tod ḱeḱluwōs owis aǵrom ebʰuget.
english: Having heard this, the sheep fled into the plain.

pie: h₁yód sénom dedórḱth₂e h₂yéwHon úd sth₂dʰí. sénom ḱl̥nudʰí só wóyde. h₂yuHn̥téh₂ h₂epó léytt. yóh₁r̥ ph₂térm̥ ǵorh₂éyeti. h₂yéwHō h₂wékst. h₁yós wr̥ǵyéti só Hwérdʰt.
english: When you see the old one, young one, stand up. Listen to the old one: he knows. Youth goes away. The year makes the father old. The young one grows up. He who works becomes strong.

pie: súHnu h₁uséwōm déh₃tōr gʷr̥Htós h₁ésti. h₁yós ne dédeh₃ti só gʷr̥Htós ne h₁ésti. deywṓm gʰóstis h₁ésti. h₁épt mértis sénom. gʰóstis ph₂wéni sédyeti. h₁yós memógʰe só déh₃tu.
english: Son, the giver of good things is praised. He who does not give is not praised. The guest is the gods'. Death seizes the old one. The guest sits at the fire. Whoever is able, let him give.

pie: h₂yéwHon gʰóstim péh₂wr̥ wédʰe. gʰóstim h₂éle. gʰóstim mē moréyes. h₁yós wékʷos ḱl̥néwti só memóne. ḱlutóm h₁nómn̥ ne néḱt. h₂yéwHō sénōd h₁éwkt. ǵérh₂onts wóyde.
english: Young one, lead the guest to the fire. Nourish the guest. Do not kill the guest. He who listens to a word remembers. A famous name does not vanish. The young one learns from the old one. The old man knows.

pie: ǵérh₂onts ḱwṓ wl̥kʷíh₂m̥ h₁épt. léytt séh₂. stunédt gʰóstipotis ǵérh₂ontm̥ ḱwónm̥. ḱwṓ gʰóstipoteyey mléwHt. h₁ésm̥ gʰóstipoti h₂yuHn̥ḱós h₂léksom-kʷe h₂ówins. nu sénos h₁ésmi. mē me stunéds. sénōm wérǵom memn̥dʰí.
english: The old dog seized the she-wolf. She went away. The master struck the old dog. The dog said to the master: "Master, I was young, and I guarded the sheep. Now I am old. Do not strike me." Remember the work of the old ones.

pie: kʷíd h₁ésti gʰóstis-kʷe gʷówes-kʷe h₂éwis h₁yód h₁yénti h₁yód-kʷe ǵʰmés h₁nédʰt? h₁ésti tód bʰréh₁wr̥.
english: What is it to which the guest, the cattle and the sheep go, and which comes forth from the earth? It is the spring.

pie: skʷálos wédni snéh₂t sn̥h₂wé-kʷe dʰǵʰúHes. wéwket skʷálos dʰǵʰúHobʰos. kʷís h₂ékʷeh₂s h₁esh₂ós h₁ésti? dʰǵʰúHes bʰih₂ént skʷént-kʷe skʷálōy. skʷále h₂ékʷeh₂s h₁esh₂ós h₁ési. h₂éḱh₃t skʷálos péyskm̥. méǵh₂s dʰǵʰúHn̥s gʷr̥h₃éti.
english: The sheatfish was swimming in the water, and the fishes were swimming. The sheatfish said to the fishes: "Who is the master of the water?" The fishes became afraid and said to the sheatfish: "Sheatfish, you are the master of the water." The sheatfish ate up a fish. The great one devours the fishes.

pie: h₂ówis h₂ékʷeh₂m bʰr̥h₁wéni píph₃et. nu gʷémt wĺ̥kʷos wérh₁t-kʷe tósyeh₂ey. h₂ówi méne wódr̥ píph₃esi. kʷís toy méne wódr̥ déh₃t? séh₂ wéwket. téwe wódr̥ ne h₁ésti. deywṓm bʰréh₁wr̥ h₁ésti. lémbʰt só tā́m. wĺ̥kʷos moysóm h₂isḱéti widét-kʷe wékʷos.
english: A sheep was drinking water at the spring. Then the wolf came and said to her: "Sheep, you drink my water. Who gave you my water?" The sheep said: "The water is not yours. The spring is the gods'." He seized her. The wolf seeks a sheep and finds a word.

pie: h₂éwis kósloy sédyet. kʷéḱt wl̥kʷíh₂s tā́m h₂éǵt-kʷe tósyeh₂ey. ní gʷm̥yé. wṓkʷs toy h₁uséwih₂ h₁ésti. wókʷm̥ toy ḱléwsōh₂. h₂éwis sékʷt. wĺ̥kʷih₂ dʰrówgʰom wérh₁yesi. ǵn̥néh₃mi te. ní ne gʷm̥yóh₂. léytt wl̥kʷíh₂s. h₁yós wl̥kʷih₂és wékʷos ḱl̥néwti mért só.
english: A bird was sitting on a hazel. The she-wolf saw her and said to her: "Bird, come down. Your voice is good. Let me listen to your voice." The bird said: "She-wolf, you are saying a lie. I know you. I do not come down." The she-wolf went away. He who listens to the she-wolf's word dies.

pie: kʷíd h₁ésti dʰǵʰúHs h₁yósmi gʷíh₃weti h₂ówis h₁yód píph₃eti péh₂wr̥ h₁yósmi néḱt? tód h₂ékʷeh₂ h₁ésti.
english: What is it in which the fish lives, which the sheep drinks, in which fire vanishes? It is water.

pie: moysṓs tr̥mént. h₁ludʰónt wl̥kʷíh₂m̥ h₂ǵént-kʷe tósyeh₂ey. wĺ̥kʷih₂ nos wĺ̥kʷoybʰos h₂lékse. séh₂ wéwket. h₂léksōh₂ wos. nu h₂éḱh₃t séh₂ tā́s. wĺ̥kʷos h₂ówins ne péh₂sti tā́s h₁édti.
english: The sheep trembled. They arrived at the she-wolf and said to her: "She-wolf, protect us from the wolves." She said: "I will protect you." Then she ate them up. The wolf does not guard sheep; he eats them.

pie: súHnu h₃rḗǵs moysóns wĺ̥kʷōd péh₂sti. h₃rḗǵs h₁uséwōm déh₃tōr h₁ésti. h₃rēǵés h₁nómn̥ stestóh₂e. h₃rḗǵs gʰóstim ne gʷʰénti. ḱléwos h₃rēǵés wérǵom sékʷetor. h₃rḗǵs-ge mért.
english: Son, a king guards the sheep from the wolf. The king is a giver of good things. The king's name stands. The king does not kill a guest. Fame follows the king's work. The king himself dies.

pie: h₂yéwHon h₂usési wr̥ǵyé. swóm wérǵom wr̥ǵdʰí. wérǵom tóm h₂élete h₁yós wr̥ǵyéti. h₁yós sédyeti só ne h₁édti. h₁yós h₂éǵrom h₂éryeti só h₁édti. h₁yós ḱémh₂t só h₃péwst.
english: Young one, be at work at dawn. Do your own work. Work nourishes him who is at work. He who sits does not eat. He who ploughs the field eats. Whoever toils becomes rich.

pie: moysós ḱunéy bʰéh₂t. h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m bʰéroh₂. kʷíd dʰédʰeh₁si? h₂éǵt ḱwṓ. h₁esh₂ósyo wérǵom dʰédʰeh₁mi. tóm h₂léksoh₂. ḱléwt gʰóstipotis tóh₁ tóybʰos-kʷe sékʷt. moysósyo wérǵom méǵh₂ h₁ésti ḱunés-kʷe wérǵom méǵh₂ h₁ésti. swóm wérǵom wr̥ǵtóm.
english: The ram spoke to the dog: "I carry wool. What do you do?" The dog said: "I do the work of the master. I protect him." The master heard them and said to the two of them: "The work of the ram is great, and the work of the dog is great. You two, do your own work."

pie: kʷíd h₁ésti h₁yód gʷm̥yéti h₁yód h₁éyti h₁yód ph₂térm̥ ǵorh₂éyeti h₂yuHn̥ḱós-kʷe h₁yósmi h₂wékst? h₁ésti tód yóh₁r̥.
english: What is it that comes, that goes, that makes the father old, and in which the young one grows? It is the year.

pie: kʷíd h₁ésti h₁yód dʰéǵʰōm gʷʰr̥néwti h₁yód h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m h₂sowséyeti h₁yód h₂wést? h₁ésti tód sóh₂wl̥.
english: What is it that warms the earth, that dries the wool, that becomes bright at dawn? It is the sun.

pie: h₂yéwHon ń̥dʰgʷʰitom ḱléwos h₂isḱé. ḱléwos wérǵom sékʷetor. h₁yós h₃épos dʰédʰeh₁ti tósyo h₁nómn̥ ḱlutṓys h₁ésti. deywós te h₂ḱh₂owsyéti. dʰrówgʰom mē h₂isḱés. wérǵom memn̥dʰí.
english: Young one, seek imperishable fame. Fame follows work. Whoever does the work, his name is famous. The god hears you well. Do not seek a lie. Remember the work.

pie: h₂éwis bʰr̥h₁wéni sédt. nu kʷéḱt péyskm̥ wérh₁yet-kʷe tósmey. péysk h₂ékʷeh₂i snéh₂si dyḗm-kʷe úd h₁éymi. péysks wéwket. h₂éwi úd ne h₁éymi túH-kʷe ne snéh₂si. dyḗws h₂wéyey h₁ésti h₂ékʷeh₂ piskéy h₁ésti.
english: A bird sat down at the spring. Then she caught sight of a fish and said to it: "Fish, you swim in the water, and I go up to the sky." The fish said: "Bird, I do not go up, and you do not swim." The sky is for the bird, the water for the fish.

pie: kʷís h₁ésti h₁yóm ḱléwsesi tóm ne dedórḱth₂e h₁yós snóygʷʰom h₂éǵeti? h₁ésti só h₂énh₁mos.
english: Who is it whom you hear but do not see, who drives the snow? It is the wind.
